changelog:
wenwei-context-build 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a skill for recursively tracing code from a specified entry file.
- Generates structured technical documentation focusing on code implementation details (structure, dependencies, signatures, core logic).
- Supports both frontend (component trees, hooks, store, API modules) and backend (controller-service-repository) scenarios.
- Implements strict output rules: precise code locations, mandatory inclusion of core code snippets, and code-first documentation.
- Provides a standardized Markdown template for knowledge base output, dynamically adapting to project type (frontend/backend/fullstack).
